title: Microbial communities for bioremediation of nitrogen-containing organic pollutants
description: The triplicate phenol-stimulated activated sludges were constructed for aerobic treatment of nitrogen-containing organic pollutants (i.e., indole, pyridine and quinoline), and glucose-stimulated sludges were performed as control. The microbial community compositions and structures were revealed by Illumina MiSeq sequencing of 16S rRNA gene amplicons.
samples: MIMS Environmental/Metagenome sample from activated sludge metagenome
